summary: Tested client-side image compression feature for Stratégie & Expertise Santé. All compression constants verified in DocumentUploader.jsx: COMPRESS_THRESHOLD=2MB, COMPRESS_MAX_DIM=2400, COMPRESS_QUALITY=0.82. compressImage() function exists and uses Canvas API. Frontend UI shows correct dropzone text, file input accepts correct formats. Backend POST /api/extract-document-text correctly rejects files >50MB with status 'too_large'. Admin login and homepage work correctly.
